key_insight: FedSSMCoOp is a lightweight federated few-shot learning framework that uses state-space model (SSM) vision and cross-modal blocks to improve biomedical image classification without sharing data or relying on an external LLM.
clinical_relevance: This could support privacy-preserving AI deployment across hospitals where labeled biomedical images are scarce and data cannot be centralized.
method: Uses Vision Mamba and Cross Mamba SSM blocks for multimodal feature alignment.
Trains only soft-prompt and communication-prompt updates in a federated setting.
Avoids an external LLM to reduce compute and communication overhead.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports evaluation on multiple biomedical image datasets, with stable performance versus baselines and an average model that is 1.96× lighter.
watch_item: Performance claims are based on the abstract; real-world usefulness will depend on robustness across institutions, datasets, and federated system settings.
paper_title: FedSSMCoOp: SSM Encoders for light-weight Federated Prompt Learning for Few-shot Classification
